title: Donovan Clingan on Ja Morant: 'He's a great teammate, he's supportive'
text:
Donovan Clingan on Ja Morant: 'He's a great teammate, he's supportive' Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Donovan Clingan on Ja Morant: 'He's a great teammate, he's supportive'
 HoopsHype Nov. 10, 2026, 8:43 p.m. ET You’ve raved about Ja Morant as a teammate. How so? Clingan: “He’s a great teammate. He’s supportive. He’s in our ears, helping us out and coaching us up. I feel like that’s what we need. He’s sharing what he sees out there and what we can do better.”
